title: A question's option descriptions line up in a column of their own
body:
`form_row` in `ui.rs` lays out each option of a question on its own. A description that fits beside its option's title shares the title's line, and one that does not goes on its own lines under the title. So one long description sits apart from the rest of the question's descriptions.

## Proposal

- Each question with descriptions has a title column, as wide as its widest option title and mark, capped so the description column keeps at least 16 columns. A title wider than the cap wraps inside it.
- Every description starts two columns after the title column and wraps inside its own column.
- A box too narrow for both columns puts every description of the question under its title.
- Each question is aligned on its own.
